hook: Kuldeep Yadav added more IPL wins than Rishabh Pant in all 4 seasons they both played. Delhi just swapped them.
lines: Plus 2.3 wins for Kuldeep, minus 1.3 for Pant.
Lucknow paid 27 crore for Pant after 81 bids.
He was below par in 18 of his 26 innings there, but still made 118 off 61.
At the Kotla he's 17 runs above par per 100 balls.
And Lucknow's ground suits Kuldeep: 7.4 an over there, 9.3 at Delhi.
Delhi's new wrist spinner, Zeeshan Ansari, went at 9.8 an over last season.
